items.quote: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am the LORD.
items.claim: In the text, the LORD tells Moses to instruct Aaron and his sons to keep themselves apart from the holy things the children of Israel dedicate, so that they do not profane the LORD's holy name in those dedicated things.
items.action: commands separation from hallowed things to avoid profaning the holy name
items.object: Aaron and his sons; the holy things of the children of Israel
items.mechanism: divine command passed through Moses to the priests
